youtube_description: Lt. Col. Nir Nitzan (res) of the IDF, interviewed by Rabbi Isaac Jeret, less than two-miles west of the Gaza Strip, outside several residences at Kibbutz Saad that were evacuated due to repeated bombardment by Hamas and other Palestinian terrorists over the course of the last eight years.  Lt. Col. Nitzan challenges the prevailing assumption that should Israel defeat Hamas, a two-state solution, with security for Israel, could be achieved in partnership with The Palestinian Authority (PA), the political body representing Palestinians living in Judea and Samaria and whose majority consists of the Mahmoud Abbas Fatah Party (the political wing of Yasser Arafats Palestine Liberation Organization  The PLO).  Nitzan points out that it was Arafat, Abbas, and Fatah who began firing missiles, mortars, and rockets from Gaza into Israel eight years ago and continued to do so until Hamas defeated Fatah in United Nations monitored elections in Gaza three years ago.
